hooks.command: if [ -s "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pattern-learner/state.json" ] && grep -q '"watchers"' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pattern-learner/state.json" 2>/dev/null && [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pattern-learner/bin/pattern-learner" ]; then "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/pattern-learner/bin/pattern-learner" capture-review --hook 2>/dev/null || true; fi
